question_summary: Request approval to substitute a tankless water heater in lieu of the specified storage-type unit in Spec Section 22 34 00; cost-neutral and needed before fixture rough-in/material order.
proposed_solution: Approve a tankless water heater alternate in lieu of the specified storage-type water heater.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: As a cost-neutral substitution affecting domestic hot water, this should be reviewed by the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer of record.
